title: Establish decision lifecycle for enterprise pricing experiments and integrate Security Questionnaire checkpoints
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: As we scale enterprise deals and run more pricing/packaging experiments, there is friction between rapid experiment iterations and contract-level controls (security questionnaires, custom discount approvals, and pricebook hygiene). This ticket defines a lightweight decision lifecycle that balances speed for experiments with guardrails for enterprise controls, and ensures SQ checkpoints are embedded into the pricing approval flow.

Scope: (1) Define an explicit lifecycle for pricing experiments targeted at enterprise buyers (experiment proposal -> risk review -> trial run -> contractization), (2) Add SQ integration touchpoints and required artifacts at each lifecycle stage, (3) Update the pricebook change process to support short-lived experiment bands and automated rollback, (4) Build telemetry events and dashboards to measure experiment health and contract-level regressions.

Why now: Q2 pushes several large Dedicated/Private deals and pilot pricing experiments. Without a lifecycle we risk inconsistent approvals, compliance gaps, and downstream rework on signed contracts.
acceptance_criteria: A documented decision lifecycle with RACI for experiment stages published to Confluence
Two SQ checkpoints defined (pre-experiment and pre-contract) with required artifact templates
Pricebook process updated to support temporary experiment bands and automated expiry
Dashboard showing experiment telemetry (win-rate, average discount, ARR impact) available to PM/RevOps
Pilot run completed with one live experiment and post-mortem notes
deliverables: Confluence playbook: 'Experiment Decision Lifecycle for Enterprise Pricing' (finalized)
SQ checklist and template for pricing experiments (PDF + fillable form)
Pricebook change request template supporting temporary bands and expiry fields
RevOps dashboard (Looker/Grafana) with mapped telemetry events
One pilot experiment completed and retrospective published
stakeholders: Product Management: Asha Patel (owner), Luca Moreno (lead)
rollout_plan: Week 1-2: Draft lifecycle and SQ checkpoint templates; review with Legal & Security. Week 3: Implement pricebook temporary-band support with RevOps + small UI change in Console to mark 'experiment band' and expiry. Week 4-6: Launch pilot experiment with one AE-led enterprise deal, instrument telemetry. Week 7: Retrospective, finalize playbook, and schedule rollout to Sales and Customer Success.
experiment_design: Experiment runway should be timeboxed to 30 days with pre-defined acceptance windows. Each experiment must include: hypothesis, target cohort (segments by ARR, industry, deployment type), control band and experimental bands, expected win-rate lift, max allowed discount, and SQ artifacts. RevOps will apply temporary bands in the pricebook; Legal will sign off on contract-level exceptions before signature.
approvals_needed: RevOps approval for pricebook temporary band creation
Security approval for any change that affects data residency or controls
Legal approval for contract template changes or approved exceptions
Sales leadership approval for pilot AE participation
